text: Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code. A successful app must have a responsive design, meaning it adapts smoothly to different screen sizes and orientations. A major decision is choosing between native development, where you build separate apps for iOS and Android, or cross-platform tools like Flutter, which use one codebase for both systems. Once built, apps are distributed through app stores like Google Play and the App Store, which review them for quality and safety. Finally, performance is crucial; users expect fast loading times and smooth interactions, so developers must optimize memory use and battery consumption.
